answer.reason: The BLS QCEW 2024 Q4 Connecticut statewide data for NAICS 54 Professional, scientific, and technical services is consistent with 101,396 covered jobs, while 63,500 does not match the NAICS 54 aggregate.

metadata.prompt:
Question: In the BLS QCEW fourth-quarter 2024 data for Connecticut, what was the December 2024 private-sector employment level, in covered jobs, for NAICS 54 Professional, scientific, and technical services?

A. 63,500 covered jobs
B. 101,396 covered jobs

Source citation: BLS QCEW Open Data, Connecticut statewide, 2024 Q4 (https://data.bls.gov/cew/data/api/2024/4/area/09000.csv)

Supplied draft answer: B
